alternatives: Block the repair until the record tools can accept records again
Log everything in the task file regardless of record-tool health
Suspend reporting for the duration of the repair
extracted_decision.rationale: The repair targets the decision tooling itself, so a self-referential requirement would create a deadlock unless a fallback path is pre-authorized.
extracted_decision.summary: Bug and learning reporting defaults to decision records; when the record tools themselves are the broken components, task-file logs and messages are the accepted fallback channel.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Evidence keeps flowing during the tool outage, but learnings from this window may live only in task files and messages, outside the decision store that autopilot replays.

verbatim_quote.english_translation: Report bugs and learnings via decision records, or via task-file logs and messages when the record tools themselves are broken.
